description: Maa Behen is a dark comedy thriller film that is now streaming on Netflix. It stars Madhuri Dixit, Triptii Dimri, and Dharna Durga in the lead roles.
title: Maa Behen Out on OTT: Know Where to Stream This Madhuri Dixit Starrer Film

description: Night Shift For Cuties follows two convenience store employees whose friendship is tested by a competition offering a trip to South Korea and a chance to meet their favorite K-pop stars.
title: Night Shift For Cuties Now Available for Streaming Online: What You Need to Know

description: The T-series has long been an interesting proposition in Xiaomi's portfolio. While the numbered flagship series is the showcase for the company's latest innovations, the brand’s T models focus on bringing select flagship features to a more accessible price point. The new Xiaomi 17T not only continues that formula but also marks the return of a T-series phone to India after more than four years. The handset places a stronger emphasis on photography than before, especially with the inclusion of the Leica-tuned imaging system.
title: Xiaomi 17T First Impressions

description: OnePlus 16 and iQOO 16 are expected to be launched later this year. While we wait for the formal announcement, a new leak suggests that they will be launched in September this year. The filing and development of the handste are said to be "progressing rapidly". Both iQOO 15 and OnePlus 15 were launched in the Chinese market in October last year and arrived in the Indian market in November.
title: OnePlus 16 and iQOO 16 Development Progressing 'Rapidly', Could Launch Sooner Than Expected, Tipster Claims

description: A new leak suggests Apple's upcoming iPhone 18 Pro Max could retain the same 8.75mm thickness as the current iPhone 17 Pro Max. The tipster also suggested Apple has focused much of its development effort on a rumoured foldable iPhone. Earlier reports indicate the iPhone 18 Pro Max could feature a larger battery, a smaller Dynamic Island, a C2 modem, and a variable-aperture main camera.
title: iPhone 18 Pro Max Leak Hints at No Significant Changes to Smartphone's Thickness Over Predecessor

description: Tomb Raider: Legacy of Atlantis' Steam page comes with an AI generated content disclosure, confirming developers Crystal Dynamics and Flying Wild Hog used AI during development. Crystal Dynamics has now clarified the AI use and said that the final game will be "human-crafted".
title: Tomb Raider: Legacy of Atlantis Gets AI Disclosure on Steam, Crystal Dynamics Clarifies AI Use

description: Three powerful solar flares erupted from active sunspot AR 4455, sending Earth-directed plasma clouds into space. NOAA has issued a G3 geomagnetic storm watch, increasing the chances of widespread auroras.
title: Sun Unleashes Triple Solar Flare Blast, Triggering G3 Geomagnetic Storm Alert

description: Motorola Edge 70 Pro+ has entered India's premium mid-range smartphone segment, competing with the Vivo V70 and Nothing Phone 4a Pro. The three handsets offer AMOLED displays, 5G connectivity, triple rear cameras, and fast charging support. Motorola focuses on performance and durability with the Dimensity 8500 Extreme chipset, while Vivo highlights its Zeiss-backed camera system. Nothing differentiates itself through its Glyph Matrix interface and unique design. Here's a detailed comparison of their pricing, specifications, cameras, battery life, and software.
title: Motorola Edge 70 Pro+ vs Vivo V70 vs Nothing Phone 4a Pro: Price in India, Specifications and Features Compared

description: Samsung has reportedly filed trademark applications for a Carbon Standing Case in multiple markets, including the UK, Australia, Canada, and South Korea. Samsung previously used the same branding for an accessory launched alongside its Galaxy Z TriFold smartphone. This sparked speculation that Samsung could be preparing a Carbon Standing Case for the Galaxy Z Fold 8 and Galaxy Z Fold 8 Ultra.
title: Samsung Reportedly Developing Carbon Standing Case for Galaxy Z Fold 8, Galaxy Z Fold 8 Ultra

description: The Los Angeles County Sheriff’s Department has warned football fans about a rise in FIFA World Cup-related crypto scams. Authorities say cybercriminals are using fake websites, advertisements, and payment requests to target fans seeking tickets, merchandise, and streaming services.
title: FIFA World Cup 2026: LASD Issues Warning Over Crypto Scams Days Ahead of World Cup

description: Nintendo Switch 2 will be reintroduced next year with a new variant, featuring an easily removable and replaceable battery, the company hinted in a document available on its website. The company said that its current devices with model numbers BEE will be reintroduced in 2027 with an additional code “OSM”, visible on the packaging, while meeting the requirements stated by the EU law. Published by the EU Parliament in July 2023, Regulation (EU) 2023/1542, concerning batteries and waste batteries, mandates that “certain appliances” sold in the region feature removable and replaceable portable batteries, which can be removed by the end-users using widely available commercial tools.
title: Nintendo Switch 2 Could Get a Removable Battery Variant Next Year to Comply With EU Regulations

description: Xiaomi 17T is now official in India with a Leica-tuned camera unit and a MediaTek Dimensity 8500-Ultra SoC. In the Indian market, the new phone is set to rival the Vivo X200T and Samsung Galaxy A57 5G. All three phones have 5G support,  120Hz refresh rate displays and 50-megapixel triple rear camera units. Here's a quick comparison of the Xiaomi 17T, Vivo X200T and Samsung Galaxy A57 based on their price and specifications.
title: Xiaomi 17T vs Vivo X200T vs Samsung Galaxy A57: Price in India, Specifications and Features Compared

description: Vi and Meta have launched Silent Mobile Verification (SMV) in India as part of their new partnership, the companies announced on Thursday. Soon, Vi subscribers in the country will be able to log in to WhatsApp, Facebook, and Instagram by simply entering their phone number. With the SMV technology, Meta’s social media apps will send a verification signal to Vi’s cellular network seeking confirmation of authenticity. Once verified, the user will be able to log in to the social media app without entering a password or an OTP.
title: Vi Unveils Silent Mobile Verification for ‘Faster’ Verification on WhatsApp, Instagram and Facebook in India

description: Amazon on Thursday announced a suite of new AI-powered features for visual search. With the introduction of eight new tools, the e-commerce giant aims to make product discovery easier and more intuitive across its shopping platform. Amazon says the features leverage AI, image recognition, and camera-based search to help users search for products using natural language commands, images, and even real-world objects.
title: Amazon Expands Visual Search With AI-Generated Product Previews, Lens Live and Circle to Search Features

description: Coinbase has frozen over $3 million in crypto assets linked to scam networks operating in Southeast Asia. The operation involved Meta, Microsoft, Starlink, law enforcement agencies, and international partners, leading to arrests, account removals, and infrastructure takedowns.
title: US DoJ Targets Scam Networks in Southeast Asia, Freezes $3 Million in Joint Operation Involving Coinbase, Meta, Microsoft and Starlink

description: Gram Chikitsalay Season 2 follows Dr Prabhat’s continued efforts to improve healthcare in the village of Bhathkandi amid humorous and challenging situations.
title: Gram Chikitsalay Season 2 OTT Release Date: When and Where to Watch it Online?

description: Dridam follows a police officer investigating a murder case connected to human remains, uncovering shocking crimes and hidden secrets along the way.
title: Dridam OTT Release Date: When and Where to Watch Shane Nigam’s Crime Thriller Online

description: Infinix Smart 20 will be launched in India on June 8 at 12 pm IST, the smartphone maker revealed on Thursday. The new smartphone is set to succeed the Infinix Smart 10 in the country. The handset will be available for purchase in India via Flipkart. It will be offered in four colour options, including Cloudline Blue, Polaris Titanium, Shadow Black, and Sunlike Orange. The new Infinix Smart 20 will be powered by a MediaTek Helio G81 Ultimate chipset in India. The handset will sport a 6.78-inch display.
title: Infinix Smart 20 India Launch Date Confirmed as Microsite Reveals Key Specifications, Features

description: Sony has introduced a new Sandstone colour variant of the WH-1000XM6 wireless noise-cancelling headphones in India. The headphones retain the same specifications as the standard model, including Sony's HD Noise Cancelling Processor QN3, a 12-microphone system, LDAC support, and 360 Reality Audio Upmix for Cinema. The Sandstone finish was first unveiled globally in May. Priced at Rs. 39,990, the headphones join the existing Black, Platinum Silver, Midnight Blue, and Sand Pink options available in India.
title: Sony WH-1000XM6 Now Available in India in New Sandstone Finish: Price, Features

description: Future James Bond games will be published by Amazon Games, the company has said. Amazon, which acquired the rights to the Bond franchise from Eon Productions last year, was not involved in 007 First Light, which was developed and published by IO Interactive. Any future sequels, however, will be done by MGM and Amazon Game Studios.
title: 007 First Light Sequels Will Published by Amazon Games, Company Confirms

description: Samsung has announced a major update to its Samsung Health app ahead of the launch of the next-generation Galaxy Watch. The new suite of features will debut in the next-generation Galaxy Watch. The update will begin rolling out on June 8. With the latest update, the Health app gains features like Vitals, Heart Health Score, Daily Cardio Load, and Fitness Index. The Vitals feature analyses five overnight bio-signals against their true resting baseline.
title: Samsung Revamps Health App Brings Vitals and Heart Health Score Ahead of Galaxy Watch 9 Launch

description: Google has started testing a new tool in select markets that will give more control to website owners on how their websites appear in Google's AI Overviews, AI Mode in Search, and AI Overviews in Discovery, based on their preferences and the user behaviour. With the new tool, publishers can stop the links and content from their website from appearing in AI-powered summaries integrated within Google’s search interface. The company said that the toggle for the same will appear in the Search Console.
title: Google Begins Testing New Tools to Let Website Owners Opt Out of AI Overviews, AI Mode in Search

description: Xiaomi has launched the TV FX Mini LED Series in India in 43-inch, 55-inch, 65-inch, and 75-inch screen sizes. The lineup features 4K QD Mini LED displays with Full Array Local Dimming, HDR10+, Filmmaker Mode, and Fire TV integration. The televisions are powered by a quad-core Cortex-A55 processor paired with 2GB RAM and 32GB storage. Other highlights include Dolby Audio, DTS:X support, Alexa integration, dual-band Wi-Fi, and introductory prices starting at Rs. 29,999.
title: Xiaomi TV FX Mini LED Series With Up to 75-Inch Screens Launched in India: Price, Features

description: Capcom has announced the release date for Onimusha: Way of the Sword. The action-adventure title will release on PC, PS5, and Xbox Series S/X on September 25, 2026. A playable demo for the game is now live, too. Onimusha: Way of the Sword demo is out now on Steam, Epic Games Store, PS5, and Xbox Series S/X.
title: Onimusha: Way of the Sword Launches September 25, Playable Demo and Pre-Orders Now Live

description: Xiaomi 17T was launched in India on Wednesday. It is the latest entrant in the flagship Xiaomi 17 lineup, equipped with Leica-tuned cameras and a dedicated 5x periscope telephoto lens. The new handset sports a 6.59-inch AMOLED screen. It is powered by the MediaTek Dimensity 8500-Ultra processor, coupled with 12GB of LPDDR5x RAM. The Xiaomi 17T runs Android 16-based HyperOS 3 out of the box. It packs a 6,500mAh battery with 67W fast charging support.
title: Xiaomi 17T Launched in India With Leica-Tuned Triple Rear Cameras, Dimensity 8500-Ultra SoC: Price, Specifications

description: Motorola Edge 70 Pro+ has been launched in India as the latest addition to the company’s Edge 70 lineup. The handset will go on sale in the country via Flipkart and the Motorola India online store in three colour options, namely Pantone Chicory Coffee, Pantone Stormy Sea, and Pantone Zinfandel. The handset is powered by a 4nm octa core MediaTek Dimensity 8500 Extreme chipset, delivering a peak clock speed of 3.4GHz. It carries a triple rear camera system, with a 50-megapixel main camera. The handset also gets a 6,500mAh battery with support for 90W wired and 15W wireless fast charging.
title: Motorola Edge 70 Pro+ Launched in India With 6,500mAh Battery, 50-Megapixel Telephoto Camera: Price, Features

description: Xiaomi 18 Pro Max is shaping up to be a powerful smartphone. Previous rumours have hinted at the display and battery, and a new leak has clarified some camera details. It is tipped to come with two 200-megapixel rear cameras. The Xiaomi 18 Pro Max is likely to launch in the fourth quarter of this year alongside the Xiaomi 18 Pro and Xiaomi 18. It could come with a Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 6 Pro SoC and a 6.9-inch screen.
title: Xiaomi 18 Pro Max Leak Reveals Key Specifications Including Dual 200-Megapixel Rear Camera Setup

description: Amazfit Balance 3 and Balance Ultra smartwatches have been introduced in the US. Both models feature 1.5-inch AMOLED displays with sapphire glass protection, 64GB storage, dual-band GPS, and support for more than 180 sports modes. The watches integrate with Amazfit's Hybrid Training System through the Zepp App and include Hyrox training tools, advanced health monitoring, and offline maps. The Balance Ultra offers a titanium build and up to 30 days of battery life, while the Balance 3 delivers up to 21 days.
title: Amazfit Balance 3, Balance Ultra Launched With Hyrox Tools, Up to 30-Day Battery Life: Price, Features

description: OnePlus Turbo 6X is rumoured to be in development as the latest model in the performance-focused Turbo lineup. Ahead of its anticipated debut, OnePlus executive has confirmed that the handset will debut in China before the end of the month. While specifications are yet to be revealed by the brand, leaks suggest that it could be powered by the Dimensity 7300 chipset. As per a tipster, the OnePlus Turbo 6X could feature a 144Hz LCD screen and pack a 7,000mAh battery.
title: OnePlus Turbo 6X China Launch Confirmed for June as Tipster Leaks Specifications

description: Bitcoin traded near $64,000 as continued ETF outflows, leveraged liquidations, and weak investor sentiment weighed on crypto markets. Analysts said capital rotation into traditional assets, uncertainty around US monetary policy, and declining demand for large-cap cryptocurrencies are keeping traders cautious despite hopes for future regulatory clarity.
title: Cryptocurrency Market Remains Under Pressure as Bitcoin Price Slides Toward $64,000

description: Apple reportedly agreed to submit the financials of its India ‌business to India's antitrust body as part of an investigation that found the US firm abused its market position. Apple reportedly agreed to supply its India financials, which the watchdog typically needs for penalty calculations. The case is considered important for Apple, as the country is a key growth market where it has expanded production. iPhone accounts for nine percent ​of India's smartphone market according to the Counterpoint Research data.
title: Apple Reportedly Agrees to Hand Over India-Specific Financial Data to CCI in Years-Long Antitrust Case

description: Apple has reportedly doubled its 2026 MacBook Neo shipment target from five million to 10 million units following stronger-than-expected demand, according to TF Securities analyst Ming-Chi Kuo. The affordable laptop starts at $599 (roughly Rs. 57,300) in the US and Rs. 69,900 in India. Kuo said buyers are choosing the MacBook Neo for its price, design, and ecosystem benefits rather than on-device AI capabilities. He also argued that growing interest in low-cost mini PCs similarly reflects demand for practical computing rather than local AI processing.
title: Apple Doubles MacBook Neo Output as Budget Laptop Gains Popularity, Analyst Says

description: Dashlane, a password manager, has announced that on May 31, an “external party” launched a “brute force attack” against select user accounts. The tech firm claims that an attempt was made to breach Dashlane’s two-factor authentication protections to register “new devices” for existing user accounts, illegitimately gaining access to their password vaults and credentials. A password vault is meant to store multiple passwords for users in one place, while attempting to keep them secure. However, this is not the first time such an attempt has been made against a password manager. In 2022, LastPass revealed that hackers had managed to access its source code to steal passwords.
title: Dashlane Password Manager Reveals Hackers Stole Some Encrypted Vaults Using Brute-Force Attacks

description: Instagram is now alerting users whose accounts were part of the recent wave of account takeover by hackers. The issue, linked to Meta AI, surfaced last week when several users reported that attackers were exploiting the AI chatbot to access Instagram accounts. The Menlo Park-based tech giant said that the vulnerability has since been patched; however, reports of compromised accounts surfaced even after the fix was announced.
title: Instagram Begins Warning Users Affected by Meta AI Hack That Enabled Account Takeovers

description: Apple’s Worldwide Developers Conference (WWDC) 2026 is all set to take place next week. The Cupertino-based tech giant is expected to preview its next-generation operating systems for the iPhone, iPad, and Mac. Ahead of the annual developer conference keynote on June 8, Apple has confirmed that macOS Tahoe will be the final major macOS release to support Intel-based Mac computers. The upcoming operating system, expected to be unveiled as macOS 27 during the event, will require Apple silicon hardware.
title: Apple Confirms macOS 27 Will End Support for Intel Macs Ahead of WWDC 2026
